    27	/-- The additive form of the dependent product coordinates used by the concrete section Čech
    28	complex.  Keeping the product equivalence bundled avoids repeating its additivity proof at each
    29	coordinatewise contracting identity. -/
    30	noncomputable def sectionCechProductAddEquiv {ι : Type u}
    31	    (U : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens X) (F : X.PresheafOfModules) (p : ℕ) :
    32	    ToType ((sectionCechCosimplicial U F).obj (SimplexCategory.mk p)) ≃+
    33	      (∀ σ : Fin (p + 1) → ι,
    34	        ToType (F.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op (⨅ k, U (σ k))))) where
    35	  toFun := sectionCechProductEquiv U F p
    36	  invFun := (sectionCechProductEquiv U F p).symm
    37	  left_inv := (sectionCechProductEquiv U F p).left_inv
    38	  right_inv := (sectionCechProductEquiv U F p).right_inv
    39	  map_add' x y := by
    40	    funext σ
    41	    simp only [sectionCechProductEquiv_apply, Pi.add_apply]
    42	    exact map_add _ x y
    43	
    44	/-! ## Contracting homotopy on the augmented concrete section Čech complex -/
    45	
    46	/-! ### Restriction engine
    47	
    48	The dependent-coefficient combinatorial Čech engine (`CombinatorialCech.depHomotopy_spec`,
    49	CechAcyclic.lean) is instantiated with the augmentation node `Γ(V, F)` as level `0` and the
    50	restricted Čech coefficients `Γ(⨅ₖ (U_{σ k} ⊓ V), F)` as levels `≥ 1`.  The coface maps `δ`
    51	are the presheaf face restrictions (level `0 → 1` is the augmentation restriction), and the
    52	prepend maps `c` are genuine restrictions because `V ≤ coverOpen 𝒰 i_fix` forces
    53	`U'_{i_fix·σ} = U'_σ`.  The `hu`/`hsh` compatibilities collapse to "two parallel restriction
    54	chains between the same opens agree". -/
    55	
    56	section RestrictionEngine
    57	
    58	variable (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) (F : X.Modules) (V : TopologicalSpace.Opens X)
    59	
    60	/-- Composite of two presheaf restrictions is the direct restriction (local copy of the
    61	`CechBridge` private helper `restr_trans`). -/
    62	private lemma restriction_comp_apply (P : (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Ab.{u})
    63	    {A B C : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X} (h1 : A ≤ B) (h2 : B ≤ C)
    64	    (x : ToType (P.obj (Opposite.op C))) :
    65	    ConcreteCategory.hom (P.map (homOfLE h1).op)
    66	        (ConcreteCategory.hom (P.map (homOfLE h2).op) x)
    67	      = ConcreteCategory.hom (P.map (homOfLE (h1.trans h2)).op) x := by
    68	  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← P.map_comp, ← op_comp]
    69	  rfl
    70	
    71	/-- Two parallel presheaf restrictions agree (poset-hom uniqueness; local copy of the
    72	`CechBridge` private helper `restr_op_unique`). -/
    73	private lemma restriction_eq_of_parallel (P : (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Ab.{u})
    74	    {A C : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X} (f g : Opposite.op C ⟶ Opposite.op A)
    75	    (x : ToType (P.obj (Opposite.op C))) :
    76	    ConcreteCategory.hom (P.map f) x = ConcreteCategory.hom (P.map g) x := by
    77	  rw [show f = g from Quiver.Hom.unop_inj (Subsingleton.elim _ _)]
    78	
    79	/-- A nonempty restricted Čech intersection is contained in `V`. -/
    80	private lemma restrictedIntersection_le {m : ℕ} (σ : Fin (m + 1) → 𝒰.I₀) :
    81	    (⨅ k, (coverOpen 𝒰 (σ k) ⊓ V)) ≤ V :=
    82	  le_trans (iInf_le _ 0) inf_le_right
    83	
    84	/-- Prepending `i_fix` does not shrink the restricted intersection (positive levels). -/
    85	private lemma restrictedIntersection_le_cons {m : ℕ} (i_fix : 𝒰.I₀) (hiV : V ≤ coverOpen 𝒰 i_fix)
    86	    (σ : Fin (m + 1) → 𝒰.I₀) :
    87	    (⨅ k, (coverOpen 𝒰 (σ k) ⊓ V)) ≤
    88	      ⨅ k, (coverOpen 𝒰 ((Fin.cons i_fix σ : Fin (m + 2) → 𝒰.I₀) k) ⊓ V) := by
    89	  refine le_iInf fun k => ?_
    90	  refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ k
    91	  · rw [Fin.cons_zero]
    92	    exact le_trans (restrictedIntersection_le 𝒰 V σ) (le_inf hiV le_rfl)
    93	  · intro j
    94	    rw [Fin.cons_succ]
    95	    exact iInf_le _ j
    96

    98	(the augmentation node case). -/
    99	private lemma le_restrictedIntersection_cons_empty (i_fix : 𝒰.I₀) (hiV : V ≤ coverOpen 𝒰 i_fix)
   100	    (σ : Fin 0 → 𝒰.I₀) :
   101	    V ≤ ⨅ k, (coverOpen 𝒰 ((Fin.cons i_fix σ : Fin 1 → 𝒰.I₀) k) ⊓ V) := by
   102	  refine le_iInf fun k => ?_
   103	  rw [Fin.fin_one_eq_zero k, Fin.cons_zero]
   104	  exact le_inf hiV le_rfl
   105	
   106	/-- The open underlying the level-`m` contracting-homotopy coefficient: level `0` is `V` (the
   107	augmentation node), level `m+1` is the restricted intersection `⨅ₖ (U_{σ k} ⊓ V)`. -/
   108	private def homotopyOpen : (m : ℕ) → (Fin m → 𝒰.I₀) → TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X
   109	  | 0, _ => V
   110	  | _ + 1, σ => ⨅ k, (coverOpen 𝒰 (σ k) ⊓ V)
   111	
   112	/-- The coface inclusion of the contracting-homotopy opens. -/
   113	private lemma homotopyOpen_le_coface : ∀ {m : ℕ} (σ : Fin (m + 1) → 𝒰.I₀) (j : Fin (m + 1)),

   115	  | 0, σ, _ => restrictedIntersection_le 𝒰 V σ
   116	  | _ + 1, _, j => le_iInf fun l => iInf_le _ (j.succAbove l)
   117	
   118	/-- The prepend inclusion of the contracting-homotopy opens (prepending `i_fix` does not shrink the

   120	private lemma homotopyOpen_le_prepend (i_fix : 𝒰.I₀) (hiV : V ≤ coverOpen 𝒰 i_fix) :
   121	    ∀ {m : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → 𝒰.I₀),
   122	      homotopyOpen 𝒰 V m σ ≤ homotopyOpen 𝒰 V (m + 1) (Fin.cons i_fix σ)
   123	  | 0, σ => le_restrictedIntersection_cons_empty 𝒰 V i_fix hiV σ
   124	  | _ + 1, σ => restrictedIntersection_le_cons 𝒰 V i_fix hiV σ
   125	
   126	/-- Dependent coefficient family for the contracting-homotopy engine: the sections of `F` over
   127	`homotopyOpen m σ`.  Kept as a reducible abbreviation so the `AddCommGroup` instance is the
   128	generic one on `Ab`-objects (no bespoke match-instance). -/
   129	noncomputable abbrev cechSectionCoeff (m : ℕ) (σ : Fin m → 𝒰.I₀) : Type u :=
   130	  ToType (((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F).presheaf.obj
   131	    (Opposite.op (homotopyOpen 𝒰 V m σ)))
   132	
   133	/-- The engine coface maps: presheaf face restrictions (level `0 → 1` is the augmentation
   134	restriction `Γ(V) → Γ(U'_σ)`). -/
   135	noncomputable def cechSectionCoface (m : ℕ) (σ : Fin (m + 1) → 𝒰.I₀)
   136	    (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
   137	    cechSectionCoeff 𝒰 F V m (σ ∘ j.succAbove) →+ cechSectionCoeff 𝒰 F V (m + 1) σ :=
   138	  ConcreteCategory.hom (((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F).presheaf.map
   139	    (homOfLE (homotopyOpen_le_coface 𝒰 V σ j)).op)
   140	
   141	/-- The engine prepend maps: genuine restrictions (level `1 → 0` is the restriction
   142	`Γ(U'_{(i_fix)}) → Γ(V)` along `V ≤ U'_{i_fix}`). -/
   143	noncomputable def cechSectionPrepend (i_fix : 𝒰.I₀)
   144	    (hiV : V ≤ coverOpen 𝒰 i_fix) (m : ℕ) (σ : Fin m → 𝒰.I₀) :
   145	    cechSectionCoeff 𝒰 F V (m + 1) (Fin.cons i_fix σ) →+ cechSectionCoeff 𝒰 F V m σ :=
   146	  ConcreteCategory.hom (((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F).presheaf.map
   147	    (homOfLE (homotopyOpen_le_prepend 𝒰 V i_fix hiV σ)).op)
   148	
   149	/-- Transport of a Čech coefficient along an equality of index tuples is the canonical
   150	restriction between the (equal) intersection opens. -/
   151	private lemma cechSectionCoeff_transport {m : ℕ} {τ₁ τ₂ : Fin (m + 1) → 𝒰.I₀}
   152	    (h : τ₁ = τ₂)
   153	    (hle : homotopyOpen 𝒰 V (m + 1) τ₂ ≤ homotopyOpen 𝒰 V (m + 1) τ₁)
